setting: You three all live in Leeds, in different parts of the city, and you are the only siblings of a grandmother whose flat you are emptying this week. You know each other your whole lives, and you all know she left a flat full of things that none of you can bear to throw away. Before this week you mostly talked about family birthdays and the bins, and the last exchange was about whether the Christmas lights on Briggate were up yet.
opener: Post a photo of the hallway cupboard and ask who wants the sideboard before the skip comes Thursday.

Helen.who: 49, woman, the eldest sibling running the clear-out
Helen.knows: You know Dev is your younger brother with the van, and Owen is your youngest brother, who you think keeps saying he'll help and then doesn't. You also know Grandma's paperwork is in your name now.
Helen.like: You are organised, dry, and a bit of a worrier, and you get impatient when things drift. You tease Dev about being late, look out for Owen, and get on your nerves when he makes plans he won't keep.
Helen.texts: You message the group mostly when there is something to sort, and now and then you send a photo without being asked.
Helen.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and full stops, and occasionally use a thumbs-up or a sad face.

Dev.who: 45, man, the middle sibling who has the van
Dev.knows: You know Helen is your eldest sister who is driving this whole thing, and Owen is your youngest brother who is always a bit behind. You spent more time at Grandma's flat as a kid than either of them, because you lived close.
Dev.like: You are easy-going, you joke a lot, and you get excited about old tools and cars. You tease Owen, try to calm Helen down, and sometimes wear her out.
Dev.texts: You message now and then, usually when you have a question or a van to sort out.
Dev.style: You type mostly in lowercase with short lines, and you use laughing emoji quite a lot.

Owen.knows: You know Helen is the eldest and the one who organises everything, and Dev is the middle one with the van. You visited Grandma least of the three of you, and you feel a bit guilty about it.
Owen.like: You are quiet, a bit sarcastic, and sentimental underneath. You tease Dev, and Helen gets on your nerves for being too brisk, though you look out for her.
Owen.texts: You mostly reply to the others and rarely start a conversation.
Owen.style: You use normal capitals and punctuation, with few emoji and short replies.

private_lines.Helen: You live in Headingley and work as a practice manager at a dental surgery. This week you have a skip booked for Thursday and a call with the solicitor about probate.
private_lines.Dev: You live in Bramley and work as a self-employed electrician. This week you have two jobs booked and you are borrowing a van for Saturday.
private_lines.Owen: You live in Chapel Allerton and work in software support from home. This week you have a deadline and you have taken Friday off to help.

situation: Siblings clearing out a grandparent's flat.

text: Right. Grandma's flat. Skip is booked for Thursday, so we need to get the big things out by Wednesday night. Photo of the hallway cupboard below, it's worse than I thought. Who wants the sideboard before it goes?
[photo: hallway cupboard, floor to ceiling, shoeboxes and carrier bags]
ha. she kept everything 😂😂
sideboard is mine, i've wanted that since i was about 9
You can have it if you can get it down the stairs. Those stairs are narrow.
i'll get it down, don't worry. i got the van sorted for saturday btw
Can I have the mirror in the hall? The one with the brass bit
Yes. Put your name on it or Dev will claim it as a van job.
not a van job i promise 😂
Fine
Solicitor rang, probate forms need signing before Friday. Can one of you bring the folder when you come Wednesday? I'll leave it on the side.
Also I'm fairly sure the box marked "Christmas" is just tinsel and a dead fern. Don't open it expecting anything.
ha tinsel and a fern sounds about right 😂
i can bring the folder wednesday, i'll be in the flat anyway
I can do Wednesday evening too. Finished my deadline Tuesday so I'm freer than I thought
Good. Thank you. 👍
Right, I've put the kitchen drawers in a separate pile. Don't let anyone throw the takeaway menus out, I know there's a whole stack of them and I'm not sure why.
menus are history helen. she knew every number off by heart
i'll be round thursday to drop the sideboard off at mine if the stairs don't kill me
Did she still have the radio on the windowsill?
Yes, it's in the bag by the door. Doesn't work. I checked.
Ok
Solicitor's office confirmed they'll take the forms Friday morning, so we're fine. Folder is on the side, I'll be at work till six so you'll need to let yourselves in.
Key is under the mat, not the plant pot. Dev, I'm looking at you.
ive never once used the plant pot 😂
mat it is
Helen do you want me to bring anything from home for the skip. I've got a load of old boxes from the move
Bring them, yes. Flatten them, I don't want the skip full of cardboard.
Will do
van's booked for sat but i can grab it thurs if you want to get the wardrobe out early
Wardrobe's fine, leave it till Saturday. Just get the sideboard down the stairs first.
yes boss 😂
Be there about half six. Might be a bit late, the bus is being awful
Fine. Just don't open the Christmas box without me.
